quotes.text: a base SQL query that joins the derived table with mimiciv_icu.icustays and mimiciv_hosp.admissions to produce a per-stay feature matrix

Each concept has a base SQL route from derived tables joined to icustays and admissions, keyed by subject, admission and stay ids. That covers name, version, platform and a task-to-record route.
